name: kiki-qq
description: QQ Bot and OneBot 11 transport adapters with private/group messaging, media receipts and read-only OneBot group tools.

interface.shortDescription: Official QQ Bot API and OneBot 11 channels

official__appId.title: QQ Bot AppID
official__appId.description: Application ID for the official QQ Bot account.

zh.title: QQ Bot AppID
zh.description: 官方 QQ Bot 账号的应用 ID。

zh.title: QQ Bot AppSecret
zh.description: 官方应用密钥；仅写入，不回显。

official__apiBaseUrl.title: Official API base URL
official__apiBaseUrl.description: Keep the official default for production. Credentials are sent to this origin.

zh.title: 官方 API 基础地址
zh.description: 正式使用请保持官方默认值。访问令牌会发送到此地址。

official__tokenBaseUrl.title: Official token base URL
official__tokenBaseUrl.description: Keep the official default for production. AppSecret is sent to this origin.

zh.title: 官方令牌基础地址
zh.description: 正式使用请保持官方默认值。AppSecret 会发送到此地址。

official__intents.title: Gateway intents
official__intents.description: Default: group/C2C messages and interactions. Request only intents granted to this application.

zh.title: 网关 intents
zh.description: 默认订阅群/C2C 消息和交互；只请求应用已获准的 intents。

onebot__baseUrl.title: OneBot HTTP base URL
onebot__baseUrl.description: HTTP API for standalone read-only group tools when the channel is stopped. A running channel uses its verified WebSocket instead.

zh.title: OneBot HTTP 基础地址
zh.description: 渠道停止时供独立群读取工具使用。运行中的渠道直接复用已核实的 WebSocket；停止后仍核对同一配置的账号。

onebot__wsUrl.title: OneBot forward universal WebSocket URL
onebot__wsUrl.description: Required to start the adapter. Connect to a forward universal ws/wss endpoint supporting events and API actions; reverse WS is not supported.

zh.title: OneBot 正向通用 WebSocket 地址
zh.description: 启动适配器时必填。连接同时支持事件和 API 的正向通用 ws/wss 接口；不支持反向 WS。

onebot__accessToken.title: OneBot access token
onebot__accessToken.description: Optional bearer token for HTTP and WebSocket; stored write-only.

zh.title: OneBot access token
zh.description: HTTP 和 WebSocket 共用的可选令牌；仅写入，不回显。

onebot__selfId.title: Expected OneBot account ID
onebot__selfId.description: Optional numeric account guard for startup, reconnect and standalone HTTP reads. A mismatch stops the operation.

zh.title: 预期 OneBot 账号 ID
zh.description: 可选的数字账号校验。启动、重连和独立 HTTP 读取均核对 get_login_info，不匹配便停止操作。

tools.name: qq_list_groups
tools.description: Read the configured OneBot 11 account’s full group list. Reuses the verified running channel; otherwise verifies the configured HTTP account. Returns accountId and transport with the list. The official QQ Bot group/C2C API has no group-list endpoint.

tools.name: qq_list_group_members
tools.description: Read the configured OneBot 11 account’s full member list for one numeric group_id. Reuses the verified running channel; otherwise verifies the HTTP account. Returns accountId and transport. Official QQ OpenIDs are not accepted.
